base_member_text: [L52,L132-L140] (HIGH/uninitialized iteration seed) dhdx and dhdy are read to form the first bottom-stress estimate before either variable has been assigned.
audit_member_text: [L136-L145] (HIGH/uninitialized value) The first nonlinear iteration computes tbnw from dhdx and dhdy before either local variable has been initialized.

base_member_text: [L147-L188,L217-L292] (MED/analytic-profile domain) The viscosity-profile construction takes multiple logarithms and divides by sigmas, sigs1, phis, and their differences without checking the required ordering or nonzero conditions; clipping delta to 0.5 can also undo its lower bound relative to sigma0.
audit_member_text: [L147-L170] (MED/singular analytic formula) Derived denominators and logarithm arguments involving sigmas, sigs1, delta, and sigma0 are used without validating their ordering or separation, allowing singular or invalid evaluations for admissible-looking shallow/rough inputs.

base_member_text: [L136-L203] (MED/library termination) Failure to converge within 30 iterations executes a bare STOP, terminating the whole host process rather than returning status through the library interface.
audit_member_text: [L201-L203] (MED/error handling) Failure of a local profile iteration terminates the entire process with STOP instead of returning a recoverable status to this library routine's caller.

base_member_text: [L59,L207-L212,L319-L323] (HIGH/layer-count bounds) The routine accepts arbitrary n but divides by n-1 and accesses sigz(2), requiring n>=2 without enforcing it.
audit_member_text: [L209-L211,L319-L323] (MED/unchecked dimension contract) The implementation requires n>=2 (division by n-1 and references to sigz(2) and sigz(n-1)) but neither checks nor documents that precondition in the interface.

base_member_text: [L79-L86] (HIGH/uninitialized variable) delta is assigned only when omega>0 but is used unconditionally immediately afterward, so a nonpositive frequency reads undefined state.
audit_member_text: [L79-L86] (HIGH/uninitialized value) delta is assigned only when omega>0 but is used unconditionally at line 86, so a zero/nonpositive omega path consumes an undefined value.

base_member_text: [L308-L326] (MED/Rouse-profile singularity) The sediment weighting divides by h and ast and evaluates a factor containing sigz-1 at the surface point, relying on floating-point infinities and unstated positive roughness/depth assumptions.
audit_member_text: [L311-L325] (LOW/floating-point singularity) The Rouse-profile expression is evaluated at sigz(n)=1 with a zero denominator whenever ast<1, relying on divide-by-zero/infinity behavior before the resulting endpoint weight is summed.

base_member_text: [L76-L82,L96-L105] (HIGH/unchecked wave-number division) The phase speed omega/k is formed before either operand is validated, so zero k can fail before the later cw>0 branch provides any neutralization.

[L86-L88,L129-L131,L172-L188] (HIGH/unchecked singular denominator) The main profile formulas divide by h, omega, and cw outside their protective branches, so zero depth or frequency remains singular even when tauwav and Qw were zeroed.
audit_member_text: [L79,L96-L110,L129,L173-L188] (HIGH/division by zero) cw=omega/k is formed without guarding k, and several later divisions by omega or cw occur even though the preceding branch explicitly permits cw<=0.

base_member_text: [L75,L118-L120,L175-L179] (MED/model-constant inconsistency) Gravity is hard-coded as 9.81 inside a model that otherwise supplies physical parameters externally, so profiles can be inconsistent with a configured model gravity.

[L98-L102,L239-L251] (HIGH/Stokes-order inconsistency) The bottom Stokes velocity passes swglm as the order selector, for which the usual value 1 enters the third-order fallback, while the vertical profile is always generated with fixed order 2.
[L334-L355] (HIGH/Stokes-formula singularity) stokes checks only omega>0 while its second- and third-order formulas divide by k and powers of sinh(k*h), so zero k or depth remains singular.
[L76,L118-L124] (MED/fractional-power domain) Negative wave energy or breaking dissipation reaches square and cube roots without a local nonnegative-domain guard.

audit_member_text: [L334-L359] (LOW/interface contract) The internal stokes routine lacks IMPLICIT NONE and INTENT declarations, weakening compile-time detection of misspelled locals or unintended argument modification.
